To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The brains of young, adult Sprague-Dewley rats were frozen, sectioned in a microtome, and incubated in a medium containing glycogen primer to demonstrate activities of glycogen phosphorylase (Pase), glycogen phosphorylases and branching enzyme (Pase + B) and of glycogen synthetases (GS).
phosphorylase (Pase) and glycogen branching enzyme (Pase + B) are demonstrated histochemically with the same medium and the same localization in rat brain.

the brains of young adult rats contain phosphorylase (Pase), Pase + branching enzyme (Pase+B), and glycogen synthase (GS) activities, which can be demonstrated histochemically by the techniques of Takeuchi and co workers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
histochemical localization of phosphorylase, glycogen synthetases and glycogen phosphorylase and glycogen synthase activities in rat brains.
the demonstration of phosphorylase, glycogen synthetases and branching enzyme activities in rat brain and their relationship to glycogen content.
the histochemical demonstration of the activities of phosphorylases and branching enzyme in brain.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
P ase, GS and P ase+ B are all localized in the cytoplasm of neurons and astroglial cells.
phosphorylase, phosphorylase + branching enzyme and glycogenesis are present in the cytoplasm of nerve cells, glia and capillary endothelium of the rat brain.
phosphorylase activity in the rat brain is confined to neurons, whereas branching enzyme is present both in neurons and in oligodendrocytes.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of cryostat sections and of the medium of Takeuchi et al. (1968) for P ase activity, and of the medium for Pase + B activity (Takeuchi & Takeuchi, 1971) for Pase activity, are to be recommended for histochemical demonstration of these enzymes in rat brain.
the localization of phosphorylase and glycogen synthase activities in brain tissue is more accurate in cryostat sections than in paraffin sections.
the use of cryostat sections is preferable to the use of en bloc incubation.
